    Key features

    Our reliable nbn plans have unlimited data, are quick to setup, and are free from lock-in contracts. We’re also 100% Telstra-owned, which means you’re protected by Telstra’s cyber security features.

    Our plans come with:

    • Unlimited data

    • Flexible plans with no lock-in contracts

    • Quick setup, with a modem if you need it

    • Dedicated support to help with troubleshooting

    Two cables are better than one

    If you had x-ray vision, you’d see twin paths throughout Belong’s internet network. It was built that way to give your connection more than one way forward. If a cable snaps or a switch breaks, that extra pathway can help your connection keep on keeping on.

    That’s on top of 24/7 network monitoring, performance testing, service health checks and a (very) dedicated network team.

    We sweat the details to help you enjoy a reliable network.
